Created `app/page.tsx` using `connection()` from `next/server` — Next.js's recommended way to opt out of prerendering when you don't need `cookies`/`headers`/`searchParams`.

How it works:
- `await connection()` tells Next.js rendering must wait for an incoming user Request. During prerendering it never resolves, so any code after it is excluded from the static build.
- The `new Date()` call after it runs only at request time, producing a fresh timestamp on every load.
